Private wb As Object, ws As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "formats.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function StateFont(c As Object) As String
